metadata.description:
Launched on July 4th, 2025, this POAP marks the creation of the POAP2RSS project — a bridge between the open web and Web3! By bringing the timeless magic of RSS feeds to the world of POAPs, it is easier than ever to follow claim activity, build automations, and share with others. It’s a celebration of interoperability, creativity, and the joyful combination of IndieWeb principles with blockchain protocols. Let the feeds flow! 📡✨

RSS feed for this POAP: 
https://app.poap2rss.com/event/191490

RSS feed for Jamie's collection: 
https://app.poap2rss.com/address/poap.thingelstad.eth
